name: Danganronpa: Objectfiedronpa
summary: This is the story of an alternate world, where, anthropomorphized objects live alongside humans, and have their own section at "Hope's Peak Academy", a famous high-school where only gifted students with incredible talents can attend to. Although it was not the initial purpose of the school, with increasingly tensions of both species against each other, not only does the school "sets them for their life", it is also used to make amends with the two species.
